tasks.name: Site Excavation
tasks.spec_text: Excavate to 4.2m below grade across Sector A. Tolerance +/- 50mm. Shoring required beyond 3m depth per OBC 4.2.3.

tasks.name: Shoring Installation
tasks.spec_text: Install soldier pile and lagging shoring system. Pile spacing 2.4m o.c. Deflection monitoring required.

tasks.name: Track Bed Subgrade
tasks.spec_text: Compact granular subgrade to 98% SPMDD. Proof roll required prior to concrete.

tasks.name: Track Bed Concrete Pour
tasks.spec_text: Pour 35 MPa concrete track slab, 450mm depth. Rebar 15M @ 150mm o.c. both ways per ASTM A615. Cure 7 days minimum.

tasks.name: South Platform Rebar
tasks.spec_text: Place and tie 15M rebar grid @ 150mm o.c. across south platform slab. All intersections tied. Cover 50mm.

tasks.name: South Platform Pour
tasks.spec_text: Pour 30 MPa platform slab, 300mm depth. Broom finish. Edge tolerance +/- 6mm over 3m straightedge.

tasks.name: North Platform Rebar
tasks.spec_text: Place and tie 15M rebar grid @ 150mm o.c. across north platform slab. All intersections tied. Cover 50mm.

tasks.name: North Platform Pour
tasks.spec_text: Pour 30 MPa platform slab, 300mm depth. Broom finish. Edge tolerance +/- 6mm over 3m straightedge.

tasks.name: Mezzanine Slab Rebar
tasks.spec_text: Place 20M rebar mat for mezzanine transfer slab. Two-way grid @ 200mm o.c.

tasks.name: Mezzanine Slab Pour
tasks.spec_text: Pour 40 MPa mezzanine slab, 500mm depth. Shoring to remain 14 days.

tasks.name: Escalator Well Excavation
tasks.spec_text: Excavate escalator pit to 5.1m. Dewatering system required. Base slab 300mm mud mat.

tasks.name: Escalator Well Forming
tasks.spec_text: Form escalator well walls. Formwork to withstand 60 kPa. Form release agent required.

tasks.name: Escalator Installation
tasks.spec_text: Install two heavy-duty transit escalators. Pit tolerance +/- 10mm. Manufacturer supervision required.

tasks.name: Track Laying
tasks.spec_text: Install direct-fixation track, 1435mm gauge. Alignment tolerance +/- 3mm. Third rail brackets per drawing E-402.

tasks.name: Platform Edge Finishing
tasks.spec_text: Install tactile warning strips and platform edge copings both platforms. Gap to vehicle 75mm max.

tasks.name: Station Fit-Out
tasks.spec_text: Architectural fit-out: cladding, lighting, wayfinding, fare gates. Coordination with systems contractor required.
